en_source: In a flashback through Phrolova's perspective, you experience her conversation with Cristoforo back in Septimont and realize why she handed you the script: Cartethyia's intervention had made their plans to overwrite reality almost impossible. To maintain control of the Threnodian's power, they made a last-minute adjustment, shifting their focus to this underwater location ahead of schedule. Giving you the script was a way to leverage your power to progress the story until the power could be separated from Mya and returned to their grasp.

Để duy trì quyền kiểm soát sức mạnh của Threnodian, họ buộc phải thay đổi kế hoạch vào phút chót, chuyển trọng tâm đến địa điểm dưới nước này sớm hơn dự kiến. Việc giao kịch bản cho cậu chính là cách tận dụng sức mạnh của cậu để thúc đẩy câu chuyện tiến triển, cho đến khi sức mạnh ấy được tách khỏi Mya và trở về tay họ.

You sense the sorrow from the music, listen to her story, and can't help but offer her suggestions, inspiring her. After the conversation, you wonder if the path Phrolova chose was influenced by your words. Had you inadvertently led her astray? You begin to suspect you are the "friend" she mentioned, yet at the same time, you wonder if any of this truly happened.

Sau cuộc trò chuyện, cậu tự hỏi liệu con đường Phrolova chọn có bị ảnh hưởng bởi lời nói của cậu không. Có phải cậu đã vô tình dẫn dắt cô đi lạc lối? en_source: Light streams from the bracelet. You've learned how to draw out Iuno's memories, and you wait as they reveal more of her hidden past. The girl who should have watched her mother's death unfold instinctively chose to shut her eyes. After losing the chance to change anything, she vowed to see everything from then on, no matter the cost. That vow led her to become a Priestess. But after countless prophecies, she began to question whether "seeing" truly meant understanding. The Lunarum Bough continues to grow, and the Iuno beside you slowly becomes more whole.
